common_instructions: Prepare a draft only. Do not create accounts, spend, register senders, activate automations, send messages or change live settings without separate approval.
Use existing authorized access available in this host. Never request secret API keys in chat. Do not assume background persistence or an installed connection; claim connected only after readback.

Disclose the extra form step and ask for approval before changing the source journey. Draft the email-to-list mapping and channel-specific consent record. Preserve opt-outs; prevent duplicate contacts and repeated welcome sends. Keep optional signup optional and do not withhold a resource that the selected Chatfuel variant delivers first.

Verify actual membership in the intended list; this can complete the list-growth goal. A saved Chatfuel email or a link click does not prove membership.
